title: SolveImplicitRungeKutta with the methods LobattoIIIA4, LobattoIIIC4-GGL and Radau3, replacing SolveLobatto4 and its four variants
author: Claude-JG
description: SolveLobatto4 of exudyn.symbolics.advancedSolvers has the variants IIIA-end, IIIC-end, IIIA-GGL and IIIC-GGL; Radau IIA is not there. Decided: three methods with two implicit stages each, named by the method and its order - LobattoIIIA4 (IIIA with the constraints at the end of the step, the simplest form that solves index 3 directly), LobattoIIIC4-GGL (IIIC with GGL at the stages, damping) and Radau3 (Radau IIA with 2 stages) -, IIIC-end and IIIA-GGL dropped; the formulas of the error estimates in the design file.
releaseNotes: SolveImplicitRungeKutta(system, simulationSettings, method) of exudyn.symbolics.advancedSolvers replaces SolveLobatto4, with the methods LobattoIIIA4 (the default; the constraints and velocity constraints at the end of the step, without numerical damping), LobattoIIIC4-GGL (the GGL stabilization at the stages, damping fast modes) and Radau3 (Radau IIA of order 3, damping), listed in implicitRungeKuttaMethods.
